chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban narrated to us, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Khazzaz. He said: I heard Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) saying:

Isa ibn Maryam (peace be upon him) said to the apostles: O Children of Israel! Do not regret what you have missed from your world when your religion is safe, just as the people of this world do not regret what they have missed from their religion when their world is safe.

key_terms.الحواريين: The apostles of Jesus; his closest disciples and companions
key_terms.دنيا: The worldly life; the transient material existence as opposed to the eternal hereafter
key_terms.دين: Religion; the complete way of life encompassing beliefs, practices, and moral conduct

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Isa (Jesus) tell his apostles about worldly loss and preserving religion?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (AS) quotes Prophet Isa (Jesus, AS) addressing his apostles with a profound comparison: believers should not grieve over worldly losses as long as their religion is intact, just as worldly people do not grieve over religious losses as long as their material world is secure. This teaching from the Islamic tradition highlights the priority of spiritual values over material concerns and illustrates the opposite mentalities of the faithful versus the worldly-minded.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (ra) narrated to us. He said: Al-Husayn b. al-Hasan b. Aban narrated to us from al-Husayn b. Sa`id from al-Hasan b. `Ali al-Khazzaz. He said: I heard Aba’l Hasan al-Rida (as) say:

`Isa b. Maryam (as) said to the apostles: O Children of Israel! Do not regret what you miss from your world when your religion advances for you, just as the people of this world do not regret what they miss from their religion when their world advances for them.
